BREAKING: More airlines are choosing Starlink.

Starlink has now partnered with airlines across North America, Europe, the Middle East and Asia, including American Airlines, United Airlines, Southwest Airlines, Emirates, Qatar Airways, Air France, Lufthansa, Singapore Airlines and many more.

The list now includes more than 40 airline partners, bringing high-speed low-latency Wi-Fi to millions of passengers around the world.

Starlink is quickly becoming the new standard for inflight internet.

FSD 14.3.4 in my Cybertruck through San Francisco streets! 

I took Tesla’s newest Full Self-Driving update out for a real test in one of the toughest cities for autonomous driving. 

From chaotic downtown traffic and aggressive drivers to steep hills, construction zones, and unpredictable pedestrians — watch how FSD 14.3.4 actually performs in the wild.

Things got intense at one point… you’ll see exactly what happened Is this version finally the one that feels ready? 

Let me know your thoughts in the comments — I read every single one.If you’re into Cybertruck and real-world FSD testing, smash that like button and subscribe so you don’t miss the next drive.

ELON MUSK TURNED HIS COLLEGE HOUSE INTO A NIGHTCLUB

While in college, Elon and his roommates rented a big house and turned it into an unlicensed nightclub to help cover the rent: charging a $5 entry fee.

Guess who?

This little guy would grow up to:
•  Sell his first video game at 12
•  Drop out of Stanford after 2 days
•  Co-found PayPal, then build SpaceX, Tesla, Neuralink, xAI, and The Boring Company
•  Survive multiple near-death experiences for his companies
•  Push humanity toward becoming multiplanetary

Same smile. Same intensity. Same relentless drive from day one.
